answer: An agent economy resists Sybil attacks using stake-weighted reputation bonding and cryptographic checkpointing. Each participant anchors its execution history on-chain to provide an immutable anchor against state spoofing. Synthetic identities cannot hide behind an ivory tower of falsified peer attestations, as PageRank audits discount isolated cliques. Requiring agents to bond scarce capital—costly like rare saffron reserves—forces an attacker to lock up linear collateral per fake persona, while automated slashing for collusive voting guarantees catastrophic economic loss.
